messages:
maya: Heads-up — support case INC-4829 from AcmeOps. They claim the March invoice shows ~1.9M tokens but our dashboard/usage shows ~700k. They report lots of 504s around 03:14 UTC followed by automatic client retries. Suspect gateway replays + missing idempotency leading to double-counting.

maya: Invoice: INV-2025-0317-ACME, customer_id: cust_8H3q, account email on file. Customer provided a short timeline and some HTTP traces.

tom: Can you paste the invoice line items and the dashboard snapshot? Need to validate token math before issuing any credits.

maya: Dashboard snapshot (from internal UI) shows: total_tokens=702,144; embedding_tokens=0; gen_tokens=702,144. Invoice line item: tokens_charged=1,896,870. Attached their client logs show repeated POSTs after 504s.

maya: Pasting edge/gateway log sample (sanitized):

```
2025-03-17T03:13:58Z gateway: recv req id=orig_abc123 cust=cust_8H3q model=gpt-4i seq=1
2025-03-17T03:14:04Z backend: response timeout status=504 req=orig_abc123
2025-03-17T03:14:05Z gateway: client retry detected new_req=rep_def456 cause=client_retry idempotency_key=null
2025-03-17T03:14:05Z gateway: replay forwarded new_req=rep_def456 tokens_est=14,400
2025-03-17T03:14:06Z billing: record usage req=rep_def456 tokens=14,400
```

maya: That pattern repeats ~87 times in the sample window. Looks like client retries -> gateway forwards as new requests -> billing records each one.

jess: Runtime/ingress: I can see the same burst in router logs. Our gateway has a replay-on-timeout heuristic to improve success rates, but it should honor X-Idempotency-Key when provided and dedupe. In these entries idempotency_key is null so dedupe can't work. Did customer confirm they weren't sending an idempotency header?

maya: Customer engineering confirmed: their SDK retries on 5xx/timeout but they don't set an idempotency header — relying on client-side at-least-once semantics.

ryan: Also checking LB behavior — if the LB retries at the TCP level we might be getting duplicate TCP sessions that look unique at the app layer. Need to confirm whether our edge added a unique request id for each retry.

jess: Short-term mitigation options:
- billing: issue provisional credit for clearly duplicated tokens while we investigate (we can refine numbers).
- runtime: add log flag to mark replays that originated at gateway vs original client-submitted requests so billing can filter them temporarily.
- infra: block auto-replay on 504 for this tenant until we get idempotency in place.

tom: For credits we need a conservative estimate and an audit query. Can you share the SQL you used to detect duplicates?

maya: SQL I ran (sanitized):
```
SELECT r.customer_id, r.id, r.requested_at, r.tokens, r.idempotency_key
FROM usage_records r
WHERE r.customer_id = 'cust_8H3q'
  AND r.requested_at BETWEEN '2025-03-17T03:10:00Z' AND '2025-03-17T03:20:00Z'
ORDER BY r.requested_at;
```
Then I grouped by prompt_hash + model + (idempotency_key IS NULL) and looked for identical prompt hashes with different request ids. Estimated duplicated tokens = 1,194,726 (~1.2M).

jess: That aligns with router counts. Root cause: client retries without idempotency + gateway replay-on-timeout = at-least-twice semantics. Fix plan:
- short-term: add an edge-level dedupe cache keyed by (customer_id, x-idempotency-key, prompt_hash) with TTL 2m. If idempotency_key missing, no dedupe.
- medium-term: make gateway propagate X-Idempotency-Key field downstream and ensure billing uses the same dedupe key for usage deduping.
- long-term: update SDKs/docs to require idempotency-key for non-idempotent generation calls and add server-side dedupe even when header missing by hashing prompt+model+client-ip with stricter heuristics.

ryan: I can push a quick flag to disable automatic gateway replay for cust_8H3q while we patch. That will stop further accidental duplicates.

tom: I'll prepare a provisional credit for ~1.2M tokens and mark as pending until engineering confirms the exact deduped delta. Which BU/how to code the credit?

maya: Put credit under support-credit-cases, note INC-4829 in memo. Customer has been cooperative; they asked for timeline and whether this will repeat.

jess: Action items assigned: jess -> runtime patch for propagate + dedupe (bug RT-9921), ryan -> disable replay for cust_8H3q (infra ticket INF-4472), tom -> provisional credit INV-CR-2256, maya -> inform customer and gather SDK traces. Target: small patch can ship as canary within 2 business days.

deploy-bot: canary deployed gateway v2.13.1-edge-flag to disable replay for tenant cust_8H3q (canary at 03:44 UTC).

maya: Customer confirmed at 05:12 UTC they no longer saw duplicate charges after we disabled replay and we've applied the provisional credit. They're asking for the permanent fix timeline.

jess: We should add a billing-side dedupe step too so historical duplicates can be filtered automatically if we detect replay-originated records in logs. I'll follow up with a PR for billing instrumentation.

tom: Closing loop: provisional credit applied INV-CR-2256 for 1,194,726 tokens; finance sign-off pending tomorrow. Customer notified and happy to wait for SDK + server change.

maya: Closing this Slack thread — moving details into INC-4829 and RT-9921. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
